soldier: The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave, the area behind the frons low and concave. The labrum is sharply rounded and spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region nipple-like, the anterior part of the labrum triangular, the sides of the middle evenly rounded, with apical, subapical and lateral-apical hairs all present, the lateral-apical hairs fine and short. The mandibles are strong, their apices strongly curved, the mandibular condyle distinct; the mandibular length 0.53–0.55 times the head capsule length and 0.89–0.91 times the head width. Antennae with 18 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-sixth, its anterolateral margin expanding posteriorly like a trapezium, the middle slightly concave; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.30–0.35. The pronotum is kidney-shaped, 1.53–1.61 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins slightly formed by two intersecting arcs, the median notch of the anterior margin more distinct than that of the posterior, with about four hairs in the middle region.
